bio.text: Andrew Clyde was first elected in November 2020 to represent Georgia's 9th Congressional District in the U.S. House and serves on the Appropriations and Budget committees.
He served 28 years as a U.S. Navy officer, including three combat deployments to Kuwait and Iraq, after earning his commission at the University of Notre Dame.
He holds a master's degree from the University of Georgia, founded Clyde Armory in 1991, and lives in Jackson County.
